_doc: Our own town walls' look (KitLook.Wall, kit.gdshader OWN_WALL; E9b1): each house's plaster tint (by its number in props_own.json walls.houses, 0-5) and timber tint (0-2, the tint's number mod 3), sRGB multipliers on the trim sheet's near-white plaster and grey-brown timber; the weathering: grime_h (m above the house's ground) and grime_dark (how much darker at the ground), splash_h and splash_dark (rain off the street), house_rise (the ground storey darker as a whole), stain_dark (streaks under sills), val_noise (broad patches), house_val (each house lighter or darker), occl (the baked occlusion's reach). Roofs (KitLook.Roof, kit.gdshader OWN_ROOF; E9b2): clay_tints and shingle_tints (by the house's roof tint, props_own.json walls.houses' fourth number, its covering the third), sRGB multipliers on the roof sheet's painted tiles; roof_sag (each roof's own extra sag at most, m, on the generator's), tile_val and tile_warm (each tile's value and warmth again), roof_val_noise, roof_house_val, soot_r (m) and soot_dark (round the chimneys), stack_soot (a stack's top), roof_moss and moss_dir (world x, z: north), roof_occl.
